title_en: National Development Planning Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated in accordance with the Constitution in order to regulate the formulation of national development plans and safeguard their implementation, strengthen the strategic guiding role of national development plans, improve the macroeconomic governance system, promote high-quality development, advance the modernization of the state governance system and governance capacity, and comprehensively build a modern socialist country.

Article 2 This Law shall apply to the formulation, review and approval, implementation and supervision of national development plans.
As used in this Law, "national development plan" means the Five-Year Plan Outline for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China, including the vision goals proposed as necessary.

Article 3 The work on national development plans shall adhere to the leadership of the Communist Party of China, be guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the Party's line, principles, policies and the decisions and arrangements of the Central Committee of the Party, adhere to the people-centered development philosophy, practice whole-process people's democracy, adhere to the complete, accurate and comprehensive implementation of the new development philosophy, focus on promoting high-quality development, coordinate development and security, comprehensively deepen reform, build a high-level socialist market economy system, fully leverage the decisive role of the market in resource allocation and better play the role of the government, and comprehensively advance the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation through Chinese-style modernization.

Article 4 A national development plan is the phased deployment and arrangement of the socialist modernization strategy within the planning period. It mainly elaborates on the national strategic intent, clarifies the priorities of government work, and guides and regulates the conduct of social entities. It serves as the blueprint and action program for economic and social development within the planning period, the important basis for the government to perform functions such as economic regulation, market supervision, social management, public services, and ecological and environmental protection, and the overarching guideline for all other plans at various levels.
The State shall establish and improve a national planning system that is led by the national development plan, based on the territorial spatial plan, supported by special plans and regional plans, composed jointly of national and local plans, with accurate positioning, clear boundaries, complementary functions, and unified coordination, so as to form a synergy of planning.

Article 5 The formulation and implementation of national development plans shall adhere to the centralized and unified leadership of the Central Committee of the Party, proceed from reality, follow the principle of coordinating all activities of the nation like moves in a chess game, uphold democracy and pool collective wisdom, and adhere to the principle of statutory planning.
The formulation of national development plans shall reflect strategic, macro and policy-oriented features, enhance guiding and binding functions, and raise the level of scientific, democratic, law-based and standardized planning.

Article 6 The State shall strengthen organizational coordination for the implementation of national development plans, establish and improve mechanisms for plan alignment, policy coordination, monitoring and evaluation, and supervision, to ensure the effective implementation of national development plans.

Article 7 National development plans shall be formulated under the organization of the State Council, based on the proposals, decisions and arrangements of the Central Committee of the Party regarding the formulation of the Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development.
The department in charge of national development plans under the State Council (hereinafter referred to as the competent department for national development plans of the State Council) shall, together with relevant departments of the State, undertake the specific formulation of national development plans.

Article 9 The formulation of national development plans shall follow the laws of nature, economic laws and social development laws, adhere to coordinating domestic and international factors, combining goal orientation and problem orientation, connecting medium- and long-term goals with short-term goals, balancing comprehensive planning with highlighting priorities, and unifying strategic and operational aspects.

Article 10 The formulation of national development plans shall carry out preliminary research.
Preliminary research shall comprehensively and deeply study major issues of overall, forward-looking, critical and deep-level significance for economic and social development, focus on national development strategy arrangements, scientifically assess the development environment and trends, accurately grasp the phased characteristics and development direction, and propose basic ideas for promoting high-quality development.

Article 11 The formulation of national development plans shall take into comprehensive consideration factors such as supporting conditions of factors, resource and environmental carrying capacity, fiscal sustainability and major risk prevention, strengthen the management of medium- and long-term government expenditure items, and enhance multi-angle argumentation and multi-option comparison for the proposed main objectives and indicators of economic and social development, major strategic tasks, major policy measures and major engineering projects.

Article 12 The formulation of national development plans shall adhere to the unity of top-level design and seeking advice from the people, improve the mechanism for public participation, encourage social participation, openly solicit suggestions from the public through the Internet and other channels, and adopt various methods to extensively listen to the opinions and suggestions of the people, enterprises, public institutions and all sectors of society.

Article 13 The formulation of national development plans shall improve the system of expert consultation and argumentation, organize experts in relevant fields to argue on relevant major issues in the formulation of national development plans, and form an argumentation report.
Experts participating in consultation and argumentation shall safeguard national interests and public social interests, provide consultation and argumentation opinions objectively, fairly, scientifically and rigorously, and shall bear the obligation of confidentiality according to law for state secrets and work secrets learned during the consultation and argumentation.

Article 14 The formulation of national development plans shall innovate formulation methods, comprehensively apply modern information technology, and fully leverage the auxiliary support role of institutions of higher learning, scientific research institutions, think tanks, industry associations, etc.

Article 15 A draft national development plan shall be drafted by the competent department for national development plans of the State Council together with relevant departments of the State, and shall be submitted to the Central Committee of the Party and the State Council for deliberation in accordance with the prescribed procedures.
When submitting the draft national development plan, the competent department for national development plans of the State Council shall attach the argumentation report and other relevant materials.

Article 16 After the draft national development plan is submitted to the Central Committee of the Party and the State Council for deliberation, the State Council shall submit it to the National People's Congress for review and approval in accordance with the procedures prescribed by law.
When submitting the draft national development plan to the National People's Congress, the State Council shall attach a summary evaluation report on the implementation of the national development plan for the previous planning period and other relevant materials.

Article 17 Before the draft national development plan is submitted to the National People's Congress for review and approval, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall organize the relevant special committees of the National People's Congress and the working bodies of the Standing Committee to conduct special investigation and research on the formulation of the national development plan in due course.

Article 18 Before the National People's Congress meeting is held, the competent department for national development plans of the State Council shall report to the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress and the relevant special committees on the basic situation and preliminary plan of the national development plan, and the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee shall conduct preliminary review. The preliminary review opinions shall be sent to the competent department for national development plans of the State Council.
The Financial and Economic Affairs Committee shall invite deputies to the National People's Congress to participate when conducting the preliminary review.

Article 19 When the National People's Congress meets, the draft national development plan shall be reviewed by each delegation, and also by the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee and the relevant special committees.
The Financial and Economic Affairs Committee, based on the review opinions of the delegations and the relevant special committees, shall review the draft national development plan and submit a report on the results of the review to the Presidium of the National People's Congress.
After the Presidium of the National People's Congress deliberates and approves the report on the results of the review, it shall distribute it to the session and submit the draft resolution on approving the national development plan to the plenary meeting of the National People's Congress for a vote.

Article 20 A national development plan shall be made public and implemented after being reviewed and approved by the National People's Congress.
After a national development plan is made public, it shall not be adjusted without statutory procedures.

Article 21 If a national development plan requires adjustment through evaluation during its implementation, the State Council shall propose an adjustment plan, after reporting to the Central Committee of the Party for consent, submit it to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for review and approval.
The adjustment plan of a national development plan that has been reviewed and approved by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall be made public in a timely manner and reported to the next session of the National People's Congress.

Article 22 The State Council shall be responsible for organizing the implementation of national development plans.
The competent department for national development plans of the State Council shall, together with relevant departments of the State, formulate implementing opinions on the national development plan, and implement them after reporting for approval in accordance with the prescribed procedures.
All regions and departments shall, based on the national development plan and its implementing opinions, specify the specific work arrangements and promotion measures concerning their respective regions and fields.

Article 23 The annual plan for national economic and social development formulated under the organization of the State Council shall maintain alignment with the national development plan, implement the development goals and major strategic tasks proposed in the national development plan, decompose the main indicators determined in the national development plan and incorporate them into the annual indicator system, set annual targets, ensure comprehensive balance between years, and reasonably determine the annual work priorities based on the major strategic tasks, etc. determined in the national development plan.
The annual plan for national economic and social development shall be submitted to the National People's Congress for review and approval in accordance with the procedures prescribed by law before implementation. The State Council shall report to the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee on the implementation of the annual plan for national economic and social development in accordance with the procedures prescribed by law.
The competent department for national development plans of the State Council shall, together with the relevant departments of the State, undertake the specific formulation of the annual plan for national economic and social development.

Article 24 The State shall coordinate the formulation of plans of various levels and types, and strengthen alignment and coordination among plans.
National territorial spatial plans, special plans and regional plans shall be formulated in accordance with the national development plan, and shall be adjusted in due course as required.
The State shall improve the mechanism for implementing the national development plan through plans of various levels and types such as territorial spatial plans, special plans and regional plans, improve and standardize management systems such as plan compilation catalogues, filing, alignment and coordination, strengthen information sharing, and ensure that plans of various levels and types are consistent with the national development plan in terms of main objectives, development direction, overall layout, major strategic tasks, major policy measures, major engineering projects, risk prevention and control, etc.

Article 25 The State shall improve the coordination mechanism between national development plans and macro policies and the work coordination mechanism, rationally determine the orientation of macro policies based on the economic and social development situation and centering on the implementation of national development plans, promote the synergy of fiscal, monetary, industrial, science and technology, price, employment, consumption, investment, trade, land and other policies, and enhance the consistency of macro policy orientation.

Article 26 All regions and departments, when formulating policies, shall conform to the direction of industrial development and structural adjustment, regional development and spatial pattern optimization determined in the national development plan.
The formulation of major productivity layout and public policies on natural resources, population, ecological environment, society, etc., shall be subordinated to the national development plan and serve the implementation of the national development plan.

Article 27 All regions and departments shall rationally allocate public resources and actively guide social resources to support the implementation of major strategic tasks, major policy measures and major engineering projects determined in the national development plan.
Central government financial funds shall be invested preferentially in the major strategic tasks, major policy measures and major engineering projects determined in the national development plan. The management and use of central government financial funds shall be carried out in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations on budget.

Article 28 The State Council shall strengthen dynamic monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of national development plans, and the results of monitoring and evaluation shall serve as important basis for strengthening and improving the implementation of national development plans.
The competent department for national development plans of the State Council shall, together with relevant departments of the State, undertake the specific work of dynamic monitoring and evaluation.

Article 29 The National People's Congress and its Standing Committee shall supervise the implementation of national development plans according to law.
The Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress and the relevant special committees shall undertake the specific work of supervising the implementation of national development plans.

Article 30 At the mid-term stage of the implementation of a national development plan, the State Council shall organize a mid-term evaluation of the implementation of the national development plan, form a mid-term evaluation report, and after reporting to the Central Committee of the Party for consent, submit it to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for deliberation.
After the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress deliberates, it shall refer the deliberation opinions to the State Council for study and handling, and the State Council shall submit a written report to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the study and handling.
The mid-term evaluation report on the implementation of the national development plan, the deliberation opinions of the members of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and the State Council's study and handling of the deliberation opinions shall be communicated to the deputies to the National People's Congress and disclosed to the public through appropriate means to accept social supervision.
Before the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress deliberates the mid-term evaluation report on the implementation of the national development plan, the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee shall, together with the relevant special committees, conduct special investigation and research and submit an investigation report to the Standing Committee.

Article 31 Before the end of the planning period of a national development plan, the State Council shall organize a summary evaluation of the implementation of the national development plan, form a summary evaluation report, and after reporting to the Central Committee of the Party for consent, submit it together with the draft national development plan for the next planning period that is submitted for review and approval to the National People's Congress.

Article 32 The competent department for national development plans of the State Council shall, together with relevant departments of the State, undertake the specific work of the mid-term evaluation and summary evaluation of the implementation of national development plans.
Article 33 Supervisory organs and audit organs shall supervise the implementation of national development plans according to law within their respective functions and duties.
Article 34 The implementation of national development plans shall serve as an important reference for evaluating the performance of duties by all regions and departments according to law.

Article 35 If any state functionary abuses his power, neglects his duty, engages in malpractices for personal gain or commits other illegal acts in the work on national development plans, he shall be held accountable according to law.

Article 36 The draft Five-Year Plan Outline for National Economic and Social Development of a province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall be submitted to the competent department for national development plans of the State Council for alignment with the national development plan; after being reviewed and approved by the People's Congress at the corresponding level, it shall be submitted to the competent department for national development plans of the State Council for filing.
The Five-Year Plan Outline for National Economic and Social Development within the administrative region of a local People's Congress at or above the county level shall align with the Five-Year Plan Outline for National Economic and Social Development at the higher level, adhere to adapting measures to local conditions, and highlight local characteristics.
The procedures for formulation, review and approval, implementation and supervision of the Five-Year Plan Outline for National Economic and Social Development within the administrative region of a local People's Congress at or above the county level shall be implemented by reference to the relevant provisions of this Law.

Article 37 The State shall adhere to the principle of "one country, two systems", and support the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macao Special Administrative Region in actively aligning with national development plans, integrating into and serving the overall national development.
Article 38 This Law shall come into force as of the date of its promulgation.
